discrepancy_with_protocol_json.resolution: Followed mission prompt sweep [10,50,100,200,500] us. This widens the dynamic range up to 2.5x the device T2 (~200us) and provides better tau_2 fit leverage; trade-off is loss of D=0 entanglement quality reference, mitigated in verifier by checking P at min delay >= 0.80 instead of >= 0.85 at D=0.
